samples.label: background
samples.text: Prior reviews of ambulatory glucose sensing emphasize drift and calibration burden as recurring deployment constraints.

samples.label: background
samples.text: Several observational cohorts have linked overnight hypoglycemia alerts with next-day cognitive fatigue scores.

samples.label: background
samples.text: The broader literature treats sensor wear-time adherence as a known moderator of real-world accuracy estimates.

samples.label: method
samples.text: We randomized 120 adults 1:1 using permuted blocks of size four and locked the analysis plan before unblinding.

samples.label: method
samples.text: Feature vectors were built from five-minute interstitial glucose windows and scored with a fixed ridge regression pipeline.

samples.label: method
samples.text: Inter-annotator agreement was measured with Cohen's kappa on a held-out double-coded subset of twenty fragments.

samples.label: result
samples.text: Mean absolute relative difference fell from 11.4% to 8.1% (95% CI 2.1–4.5) in the intervention arm.

samples.label: result
samples.text: Nighttime alert precision was 0.73 versus 0.51 for the baseline rule set (McNemar p = 0.004).

samples.label: result
samples.text: No serious device-related adverse events were observed across ninety days of continuous wear.
